pageProps.content: ## Review After finishing lunch and taking a nice, long walk around Geoje, I stopped by a cafe well known as a great spot for scenic views. It happened to be located right near our accommodation, had a wonderful view, and offered a spacious parking lot, making it look like the perfect place for us, so we headed there without hesitation. We arrived at the cafe shortly, parked easily without any hassle, and headed straight inside. Just as I had seen in the reviews, a refreshing, panoramic ocean view spread out before our eyes beyond the large picture windows. ```adcard ``` Whenever I go to a cafe, I usually just drink an Iced Americano, but this time I wanted to really get into the travel mood, so I ordered a blue drink called Island Ade. Since Geoje is famous for yuja (citron), the fact that it contained at least a bit of yuja was the main deciding factor for me. We ordered a hot Americano and the Island Ade, took the buzzer, and went up to the second floor. Since our visit was on a weekday during a quiet hour, there were plenty of available seats—enough that we could sit wherever we liked. We picked a table with a particularly nice view, and after a short wait, our drinks were served. ```adcard ``` The Island Ade wasn't quite the sweet and tangy yuja flavor I had imagined, but it was still fairly enjoyable. The hot Americano ordered with it was surprisingly rich, deep, and nutty, making it very pleasant to drink. True to its reputation as a scenic spot, we thoroughly took in the wide-open sea, sipped our drinks, and enjoyed a relaxing break. I thought it would also be wonderful to start a leisurely morning here next time with a cup of morning coffee. ## Pictures
